title: Simple and easy to use.
body: Simple and easy to use, but surprisingly deep configuration options. My only complain is that this app only supports 12 habits. Good apple watch integration.
author: anolma

title: Not workkng with latest iphone
body: Tried to start couple of streaks. First one worked for a week, but not any more. Second one could not be added as the app was unable to connect with health app, even though I gave all the permissions.
author: KatiN47

title: The super app!
body:
This is a great app for habit tracking and self management in general. 

I recently discovered that you can use it as a pomodoro timer which is great and removes the need for an extra app. It would be wonderful if it could be use to track intermittent fasting as well.
author: Il_bale

title: Visually pretty, hard to navigate, simple to mark things done
body: Nice looking app, but I find the navigation logic confusing. Because of that, it takes a while to set the goals. Marking things done is simple.
author: Paula 0987

title: Dissapointed with apple watch
body:
Has a lot of bugs with apple watch.
Everytime I open the app on iphone it just doubles the amount of streaks. Doesn’t update anything to apple health app if not opened manually on iphone. Please fix that doubling bug. It makes whole app useless because now I have to avoid opening app on iphone. I use it mainly on apple watch.
author: rustled1120

title: So far so good. Minor problems on Watch
body: The app is nice. The watch app is installed but the complication at first was nowhere to be found. I’ve tried all the possible faces. After I have selected the complication on the watch itself and restarted the Watch app on iPhone, only after that it became selectable. iPhone 6 plus, watch series 4.
author: VasilyKo

title: Wonderful
body: Even better with the latest update!
author: Omflslajf

title: Simple and effective
body: Streaks helps you form habits (if you have a mindset gamification works for). Handy features: setting tasks to be done a certain times a week; logging a task that was done yesterday (I have a chore that is done late in the evening and often I don't remember to mark it done. I can fix that the next day without losing my streakj.
author: Tero Y

title: Addictive
body:
Simple, pretty, easy to use. Really the only thing that bugs me is that I often get the same exercise several — way too many — times back to back. 

Having odd numbers of reps for moves that alternate side for each rep is also, well, odd.
author: nadisetgo

title: Works for me
body: I've used it for about 6 months now and it has worked for me.
author: hagnabit

body: Huikee appi jos haluu alkaa uusia rutiineja toteuttaa. Appi päivittäisessä käytössä ja yksinkertaisuus toimii tässä apissa täydellisesti.
author: Edu12

title: Fun and useful
body: A great complement to the "rings" on the AppleWatch. Great to be able to set my own goals, and synchronization with Healt-data works nicely
author: Junetoo

title: Loistava pikku-aplikaatio
body: Kiva apuväline uusien rutiinien muodostamiseen. Minimalistinen ja nätti käyttöliittymä.
author: K. Kepponen

title: Easy to use
body: I find this program very useful for introducing new habbits. Simple and easy to use.
author: Hotel freak

title: Excellent app
body: Very well designed and helps me to achieve my goals daily.
